description: This file contains internal testing utilities for PyTorch's JIT compiler, including test case classes, functions for comparing JIT-compiled functions with reference implementations, and shape analysis methods. It appears to be part of the internal test suite for PyTorch JIT, focusing on testing graph export/import and autodifferentiation behavior.

classes.name: JitCommonTestCase
classes.description: A test case class providing utility methods for testing PyTorch JIT graphs, including export/import validation, shape analysis, autodiff testing, and creating functions from graphs.

methods.name: check_output_types(self, func, ref_outputs, args, kwargs)
methods.description: Checks that the output type of a function matches a reference output, asserting type correctness.

methods.name: check_against_reference(self, func, reference_func, output_func, args, kwargs=None, allow_unused=True, check_types=True, no_grad=False, no_gradgrad=False)
methods.description: Verifies that a JIT-compiled function behaves identically to a reference implementation across various gradient and type checks.

methods.name: createFunctionFromGraph(self, trace)
methods.description: Creates a callable function object from a given Torch JIT graph or trace.

methods.name: assertExportImport(self, trace, inputs)
methods.description: Tests that exporting a traced module to save and then loading it back yields consistent results.

methods.name: assertExportImportModule(self, m, inputs)
methods.description: Tests that after exporting and importing a module, it produces the same output as the original.

methods.name: runAndSaveRNG(self, func, inputs, kwargs=None)
methods.description: Runs a function with a frozen RNG state and captures its output.

methods.name: getExportImportCopy(self, m, also_test_file=True, map_location=None)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a module via export and import, optionally saving to and loading from a file.

methods.name: autoDiffErrorMessage(self, should_autodiff_node, nodes_not_in_diff_graph, fusion_nodes_not_found, non_fusible_nodes_being_fused, fusion_nodes_found, nodes_in_diff_graph)
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message describing autodiff node test mismatches.

methods.name: assertAutodiffNode(self, graph, should_autodiff_node, nonfusible_nodes, fusible_nodes)
methods.description: Asserts correctness of autodiff graph structure, verifying presence of fusible and non-fusible nodes within differentiable graphs.

methods.name: checkShapeAnalysis(self, out_sizes: Union[list[int], list[list[int]]], traced_graph, assert_propagation, constant_prop=True)
methods.description: Performs shape analysis propagation on a traced graph, asserting that shapes are correctly propagated and consistent.
